schema.title: Response Get User Files V1 File Get

500.description: Internal server error while fetching files

post.description:
Upload a file to the database for the authenticated user.

The upload must be a .stl, .obj, .3mf, .amf, or .step/.stp file.

> **Playground note:** in the **Body** section, open the dropdown and select **Multipart**. Add an entry with the key `file`, then click the value field to attach your 3D model (.stl, .obj, .3mf, .amf, or .step/.stp). Without this, the request will send the raw file bytes and the server will return a `422` validation error.

500.description: Internal server error during upload

get.description:
Generate an upload ID for uploading a file to the database.

Returns an upload id that can be used with the /file/public/{upload_id} endpoint to upload files without authentication. The upload id expires after 1 hour.

Workflow:
1. Call this endpoint to get an upload_id
2. Use the upload_id with `POST /file/public/{upload_id}` to upload the file

500.description: Internal server error while generating upload ID

post.description:
Upload a file using a temporary upload ID (no authentication required).

This endpoint allows anonymous uploads using a temporary upload ID obtained
from the /upload endpoint. The upload ID is single-use and expires after 1 hour.

> **Playground note:** in the **Body** section, open the dropdown and select **Multipart**. Add an entry with the key `file`, then click the value field to attach your 3D model (.stl, .obj, .3mf, .amf, or .step/.stp). Without this, the request will send the raw file bytes and the server will return a `422` validation error.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Temporary upload ID obtained from /file/upload-id endpoint

410.description: Upload session expired or already used

500.description: Internal server error during upload

post.description:
Convert a Bambu Studio profile archive (.bbscfg) to PrusaSlicer INI format. Upload a .bbscfg file containing filament/, printer/, and process/ directories with Bambu profile JSON files. Returns a downloadable .ini configuration file.

> **Playground note:** in the **Body** section, open the dropdown and select **Multipart**. Add an entry with the key `file`, then click the value field to attach your Bambu Studio profile archive (.bbscfg). Without this, the request will send the raw file bytes and the server will return a `422` validation error.

200.description: Successfully converted profile to INI format

Convert Example.value:
# generated by Cloud Slicer

[printer:Bambu Lab X1 Carbon 0.4 nozzle]
printer_model = Bambu Lab X1 Carbon
printer_variant = 0.4
nozzle_diameter = 0.4
max_print_height = 250
bed_shape = 0x0,256x0,256x256,0x256
retract_length = 0.8
retract_speed = 35

[filament:Bambu PLA Basic @BBL X1C]
filament_type = PLA
filament_diameter = 1.75
temperature = 220
first_layer_temperature = 220
bed_temperature = 55
first_layer_bed_temperature = 55
fan_always_on = 1
max_fan_speed = 100
min_fan_speed = 100

[print:0.20mm Standard @BBL X1C]
layer_height = 0.2
first_layer_height = 0.2
perimeters = 3
top_solid_layers = 5
bottom_solid_layers = 3
fill_density = 15%
fill_pattern = grid
support_material = 0

400.description: Invalid archive format or missing required files

post.description:
Convert a Bambu Studio profile export to intermediate JSON format. Accepts .bbscfg, .bbsflmt, .zip (Printer/Filament/Process preset bundles), or a raw .json preset. Returns only the categories that were present in the upload; each present category is returned as a list of resolved configs.

> **Playground note:** in the **Body** section, open the dropdown and select **Multipart**. Add an entry with the key `file`, then click the value field to attach your Bambu Studio profile export (.bbscfg, .bbsflmt, .zip, or .json). Without this, the request will send the raw file bytes and the server will return a `422` validation error.

200.description: Successfully converted profile to JSON format

400.description: Invalid file format or no recognizable Bambu profiles
